description: Completed Infrastructure Projects by Work Category, Type, and Year is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ashghal. This dataset provides annual figures for completed infrastructure works in Qatar across roads, drainage systems, and sub-divisions. It includes data on key project indicators such as road length constructed, number of junction conversions, bridges, tunnels, tree planting, drainage networks, and plots serviced. The dataset supports planning, monitoring, and evaluation of infrastructure development over time. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Ashghal. Its tags are projects, infrastructure, roads, drainage. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-06-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
